Three dimethylsilanediols form the trimer and2H2O; four form the tetramer and3H2O. Si has four single bonds; bridge O has two bonds and terminal hydroxyl O bonds to Si and H. The formula is a bounded manufacturing/structure model, not an actual synthesis claim.

The current successor actually requires the former missing direct property comparison: the given crosslinked PDMS specimen recovers after extension while the specified PE specimen permanently deforms under the same stipulated conditions. Linear chain formation and added network links are expressly separated. Condensation of the stated difunctional finite-chain model is not silently equated with production of a network. Additional interchain covalent links are a supplied model condition that restricts chain sliding and explains recovery. Changing crosslinking at the same polymer chemistry and rejecting the universal PE/silicone ranking provide meaningful transfer; unmeasured heat/long-term behaviour remains unknown.

essentialCoverage.finding: Ester hydrolysis consumes water and changes functional-group connectivity. The released linear C12 alcohol can be represented as oxidizing to C12 aldehyde and C12 acid without immediate carbon cleavage. Under the supplied activated-saturated-chain C2-shortening model, five shortening cycles yield six acetyl units. Those acetyl units are not themselves proof that all carbon has become CO2. The branched-tail transfer prevents unproved universal pathway or rate claims.

The current body explicitly distinguishes parent disappearance, lost surfactant function, intermediate formation, sorption and mineralization. Its case requires the learner to say that90%parent removal does not itself demonstrate lost surface activity. Ethoxy-chain shortening is treated as the stipulated structural transformation; the current surfactant-specific primary-degradation criterion additionally needs the missing functional evidence. This is materially stronger than the archived shorthand answer and is present in both current language versions.

80%parent disappearance and30%organic-carbon-as-CO2, or90%parent removal and10%CO2-carbon, establish different endpoints. The solution correctly avoids subtracting percentages of different measured quantities into a fictitious complete carbon balance. Unknown phases, intermediates and biomass remain to be measured. The fresh sludge scenario requires a cross-phase balance and recognizes that sorption relocates molecules without proving chemical destruction. The aromatic alkylphenol core is not recast as a specified alkyl branching pattern or automatically given the linear-alcohol beta-oxidation route.

essentialCoverage.finding: Positive anode is right, negative cathode left; the origin and10min observation period are supplied and electroosmosis is explicitly neglected. At pH7>pI6.0 glycine has negative mean net charge and its+1mm migration is toward the anode. Glutamate at pI3.2 likewise has negative charge and+7mm; lysine at pI9.7 has positive charge and−6mm toward the cathode. The model’s signs and electrode directions are consistent.

The second full case supplies pH8 and11. Lysine is below its pI9.7 at8 and above it at11, so its stipulated−4mm→+3mm reversal is coherently explained by changing protonation including the side chain. The basic side-chain label is not treated as permanent positive total charge. Glutamate remains above its pI and both stipulated positive displacements remain toward the anode.

Both tables explicitly stipulate invented migration values; pI is used for the mean-charge sign relationship and is not incorrectly converted into magnitude or millimetres. U matching three references is compatibility, not unique chemical identification. V matching lysine at two pH values is stronger compatibility yet still allows co-migrating alternatives. Matrix, field, time and mobility remain relevant, and changed pH constitutes substantive interpretation transfer.
